_about: The kit's colours beyond art/house-palette.json, each a family made by the house rule (scripts/art/house_palette.py) from one body colour, with its warm and cool siblings and its edge tone. 'decided' holds rulings: they win over the house palette's value of the same family while the kit draws. 'families' holds proposals still to be folded into the house palette by Claude A. 'edges' overrides an edge tone: wood closes in the 1x sprites' dark brown, not near-black.
